work_completed: Built WorldEngine/Content/Web/habitat.html: a self-contained single-page AI habitat runtime with zero dependencies and no build step

Procedural world layer: seeded fBm heightfield (34x34 quads over 230 world units), baked path distance field, animated water with specular glint, time-of-day sky/sun/fog model, broadleaf + conifer vegetation, rocks, shrubs, and a settlement (bungalow row, studio block, cafe, park shelter, plaza markers) with gable roofs, wall skirts, and windows
Projective renderer on 2D canvas: camera basis + near-plane clipping + painter's-algorithm sort over ~1,970 draw items per frame

13 residents (5 Avatars, 3 Aides, 1 RRT Advocate, 4 villagers) with articulated bodies, walk-cycle limb swing, screen-space billboard torsos, ground shadow, role ring, focus arc, stress pulse, coaching halo, and name/intent labels

Simulation layer: needs decay and recovery, affect dynamics (focus/stress/load), scenario-weighted stressors, Aide pathing and logged coaching interventions, Advocate tiering GREEN/AMBER/RED/BLACK, event log

Spectator HUD: observer-only controls (pause, step, pace 0.5x-12x, scenario assignment across all 13 ADHD catalog scenarios, reseed), click-to-inspect resident card (needs, affect, traits, current intent), Aide/Advocate log, RRT tier bar, in-world place labels

Verification: node --check on the inline JS; headless DOM/canvas harness driving 900+ frames of the real render loop and real stepSim with zero runtime errors; a scanline PNG rasteriser used to visually confirm day/dusk/night/close-up frames; determinism test (same seed + same step => identical positions and needs)
blockers: Replacing the UE 5.8 authoritative runtime is an architecture decision reserved to Joshua. The UE tree in WorldEngine/ is deliberately untouched pending that decision.
decisions_made: Implemented the vision as an additive artifact (WorldEngine/Content/Web/habitat.html) rather than deleting WorldEngine/, because AGENTS.md forbids agent-made architecture decisions and two active threads (DET-001, LOD-001) assume UE is still in play
Zero external dependencies and no build step: the page must open from file:// for any stakeholder to review it, and the repo is dependency-light by design
No Math.random on the simulation path; all randomness comes from seeded mulberry32, satisfying the determinism rule in docs/world-engine/DESIGN.md section 8
Baked paths into the terrain colour field instead of drawing a separate path mesh layer, because painter's-algorithm sorting made floating path quads tear against the terrain
Billboarded the torso in screen space while keeping limbs in 3D, so residents stay readable from every camera angle

handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Open WorldEngine/Content/Web/habitat.html directly in a browser; drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, WASD to pan, click a resident to inspect, F to follow, space to pause. 'Reseed world' changes the terrain seed deterministically. If Joshua picks option 2 (UE authoritative, page as viewer), the work needed is confined to replacing the page's local stepSim with a contracts/v1 snapshot consumer plus an SSE/WebSocket feed; the renderer, HUD, roster, and scenario catalog are reusable as-is. If he picks option 1 (full retirement), also plan a WebGL backend early — the current canvas painter's-algorithm renderer is fine at 13 residents but will not hold 19-avatar-scale scenes.
